# Cell2Location

## Cell2Location

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `Literal['reference', 'map', 'full']` | `full` | `advanced` | Fit reference only, map with saved signatures, or perform both. | - |
| `reference_adata_path` | `str` | `reference.h5ad` | `advanced` | Annotated scRNA-seq H5AD containing untransformed counts. | - |
| `reference_labels_key` | `str` | `cell_type` | `advanced` | Reference obs column defining the cell types whose signatures are fitted. | - |
| `reference_batch_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Reference obs column for sample/batch correction. | - |
| `reference_categorical_covariate_keys` | `List[str]` | `[]` | `advanced` | Additional reference technical covariates, e.g. sequencing technology. | - |
| `reference_counts_layer` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Raw-count layer; null selects X. Use 'raw' to explicitly select adata.raw. | - |
| `reference_gene_id_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Reference var column containing unique gene IDs; null uses var_names. | - |
| `visium_inputs` | `List[SpatialBiologyToolkit.config.models.VisiumInputConfig]` | `[]` | `advanced` | One combined H5AD or several files, optionally with a library_id for each file. | - |
| `library_key` | `str` | `library_id` | `advanced` | Visium obs column identifying libraries/slides, used as the mapping batch key. | - |
| `barcode_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Visium obs column with original spot barcodes; null uses input obs_names. | - |
| `visium_counts_layer` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Visium raw-count layer, 'raw', or null for X. Normalized/log counts are rejected. | - |
| `visium_gene_id_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Visium var column containing unique matching gene IDs; null uses var_names. | - |
| `gene_symbol_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional var column of gene symbols, used for mitochondrial filtering in both inputs. | - |
| `mitochondrial_prefixes` | `List[str]` | `['MT-', 'mt-']` | `advanced` | Exclude genes with these symbol prefixes; [] disables this filter. | - |
| `in_tissue_key` | `Optional[str]` | `in_tissue` | `advanced` | If present, retain spots with value 1; null disables tissue filtering. | - |
| `filter_reference_genes` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Apply the gene-expression filter from the cell2location tutorial. | - |
| `cell_count_cutoff` | `int` | `5` | `advanced` | Tutorial filter: threshold on the number of reference cells expressing a gene. | - |
| `cell_percentage_cutoff` | `float` | `0.03` | `advanced` | Tutorial filter: genes expressed in more than this fraction of cells are retained. | - |
| `nonzero_mean_cutoff` | `float` | `1.12` | `advanced` | Tutorial filter: mean expression among expressing cells. | - |
| `min_shared_genes` | `int` | `100` | `advanced` | Fail mapping below this number of shared, expressed genes. | - |
| `signatures_path` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Mapping signature CSV (genes x cell types); null uses asset_folder/reference/signatures.csv. | - |
| `asset_folder` | `str` | `cell2location` | `advanced` | Reusable reference and mapping models, H5ADs and signatures. Existing result directories are protected. | - |
| `n_cells_per_location` | `float` | `30.0` | `advanced` | Global expected cells per spot; choose for the tissue. Spot priors override this mean when supplied. | - |
| `detection_alpha` | `float` | `20.0` | `advanced` | Within-library RNA detection prior: typically 20 for high variability or 200 for low variability. | - |
| `detection_mean_per_sample` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Initialize RNA detection sensitivity separately for each Visium library. | - |
| `cell_count_prior_obs_key` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Visium obs column holding registered IMC counts/expected cells per spot. | - |
| `cell_count_prior_csv` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Alternatively, a CSV with library_id, barcode and n_cells columns. Exact composite-key alignment is required. | - |
| `cell_count_prior_scale` | `float` | `1.0` | `advanced` | Explicit multiplicative adjustment for serial-section counts; record scientific justification. | - |
| `cell_count_prior_floor` | `float` | `0.1` | `advanced` | Positive floor for zero observed cells, required by the Gamma prior. Applied after scaling. | - |
| `cell_count_prior_mean_var_ratio` | `float` | `1.0` | `advanced` | Gamma prior mean/variance ratio. Lower values weaken the prior; this does not fix the posterior cell total. | - |
| `reference_max_epochs` | `int` | `250` | `advanced` | Reference regression training epochs. | - |
| `reference_batch_size` | `int` | `2500` | `advanced` | Reference training minibatch size. | - |
| `mapping_max_epochs` | `int` | `30000` | `advanced` | Mapping epochs; inspect convergence before interpretation. | - |
| `mapping_batch_size` | `Optional[int]` | `null` | `advanced` | Mapping minibatch size; null trains on all spots at once. | - |
| `posterior_samples` | `int` | `1000` | `advanced` | Posterior samples used for means, standard deviations and 5/95% quantiles. | - |
| `posterior_batch_size` | `int` | `2048` | `advanced` | Posterior sampling minibatch size, including spot-prior indexing. | - |
| `accelerator` | `Literal['cpu', 'gpu', 'auto']` | `gpu` | `advanced` | Training and posterior device. GPU requested explicitly fails if unavailable. | - |
| `seed` | `int` | `0` | `advanced` | Random seed for reproducible training setup. | - |
| `plot_top_cell_types` | `int` | `12` | `advanced` | Maximum cell types shown per library in coordinate abundance maps. | - |
